content: Official NIP-29 and current Pyramid/Flotilla/Nostrord sources show relay-scoped groups with public/private, restricted, hidden, and closed flags; invite/join flows; relay-enforced moderation; optional member/admin/role metadata; and arbitrary relay-defined role capabilities. NIP-29 private groups are access-controlled, not E2EE; full member lists are not guaranteed. Pyramid adds hierarchical membership, invite quotas, global role labels, NIP-29 groups, and root moderation. Flotilla exposes invites, room policies, reports, and roles, while distinguishing cosmetic labels from relay admin power. Cross-checked against current official repos.
